{{Top|leg}}
An '''Assistant-Viceprex''' was a rank in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] that came beneath [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]]. An Assistant-Viceprex was in charge of a smaller section of a division or a particular division facility.

[[Brollyx]] was an Assistant-Viceprex of the [[Security Police/Legends|Security Division]].
